title: AI Output Verification Record
description: An observable, per-instance record showing that a specific piece of AI-generated content (a citation, a factual claim, a recommendation) was independently checked against a named authoritative primary source before it was relied upon or submitted, including the outcome of that check.
evidence_description: A record identifying the AI-generated claim or citation checked, the primary source consulted to verify it, the date of the check, who performed it, and the outcome (confirmed, corrected, or discarded).
collection_method: Manual verification step performed by the professional relying on the AI output, logged at the point of review before submission or delivery.
retention_period: Aligned with the underlying professional record-keeping obligation (e.g. client file retention requirements for legal matters).
artifact_format: Structured log entry or annotated document trail tied to the specific work product.

citations.title: Mata v. Avianca, Inc., No. 22-cv-1461 (PKC), Order on Sanctions
citations.publisher: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York
